title: En el restaurante
grammarFocus: I would like... / Can I have...?

lesson.title: Pedir comida con cortesía
lesson.rule: Para pedir con educación: I would like... (Quisiera...) o Can I have...? (¿Me puede traer...?). La forma corta de 'I would' es 'I'd'. Para preguntar si algo es apto: Is this dish vegetarian? Para pagar: Can I have the bill, please?
examples: I would like a coffee, please.
Could I have the bill, please?
commonMistakes: I want a coffee (brusco) → I would like a coffee
I like a coffee (me gusta el café) → I would like a coffee (lo quiero ahora)
The menu, please is rude → May I see the menu, please?

pronunciationTip: 'I would like' en conversación se contrae: I'd like /aɪd laɪk/. El sonido /d/ conecta con 'like'.

phrases.en: Could I see the menu, please?
I would like a coffee, please.
Can I have the bill, please?
Can I have some water, please?
phrases.es: ¿Me trae un poco de agua, por favor?
Una mesa para dos, por favor.

exercises.prompt: Empareja cada palabra con su traducción.
Completa: I would ___ a coffee, please.
Completa: Can I have the ___, please?
Escucha y selecciona la traducción correcta.

speak: Simula una visita a un restaurante. Di: 'I would like ___. Can I have the ___, please? The food was delicious.' Habla durante 45 segundos.
challenge: Graba un audio como si estuvieras pidiendo en un restaurante. Incluye: pedir mesa, pedir comida, pedir la cuenta. Usa: 'A table for two, please. I would like ___. Can I have the bill, please?'
